blurb: Guests can enjoy hiking to waterfalls, swimming and floating in streams, fishing in stocked trout ponds, and relaxing in nature surrounded by the Chattahoochee National Forest. Accommodations include cabins with full amenities, RV sites with hookups, and tent camping near streams. The property also features a bio-dynamic farm with animals and a trout pond for catch and keep fishing.
